assumptions: P0-P3 are the four fixed prompt tests inherited from R2-PROMPT applied to every version; the version headline is the unweighted mean of the four arm means, because card SYS-OPT fixes '568 rows' and 'the same 4 tests' but not the aggregation. Recorded, not hidden.
C0 is carried as 142 additional reference rows (71 per model) rather than inside the 568, since 2 models x 4 arms x 71 turns = 568 exactly and C0 is a fifth renderer.
Quality mismatch rate = mismatches / 40 probes (20 fixed questions x P0 and P1 forms per model), with the question set and grader frozen in state/sys-opt-quality.json before round 1.
Bootstrap procedure (10,000 resamples, seed 20261024, percentile interval) is a procedural choice made at freeze time; it is not a measured number and it does not alter the card's thresholds.
V0 values are deliberately left blank: filling them requires reading R2-PROMPT, which belongs to SYS-OPT and would place a post-measurement number inside the pre-registration.
